source: Auckland Council, Auckland Unitary Plan Schedule 10 Notable Trees (Notable Trees Overlay, operative)
licence_proof: ArcGIS item 583f5e99290b4adb9f7cc1196451f1e7 (Notable Trees Overlay, owner OpenDataUser, published on data-aucklandcouncil.opendata.arcgis.com) licenseInfo verbatim: "This website and datasets are provided by Auckland Council as a public service and may be used for personal and business purposes. They are provided under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International licence." The ArcGIS Hub dataset API returns structuredLicense type CC-BY-4.0. The same text goes on: "You are not permitted to copy or republish any substantial amount of the information from this website without the prior written consent of Auckland Council." Read as applying to the website, since the datasets are expressly CC BY 4.0 and the structured licence says so; our use is map dots plus a species name, not the text of the website. Read 2026-09-24. If Auckland ever objects, this is the sentence to revisit.
designation: Schedule 10 Notable Trees of the Auckland Unitary Plan (statutory notable-tree schedule). The separate Notable Group of Trees Overlay is NOT imported, because a group is rarely a collectible point.
scope: All points of the operative overlay across the Auckland region. One schedule_id can carry several points (one per tree in the listing), and NAME can name more than one species ("Pohutukawa, Moreton Bay Fig") when a schedule line covers several trees.
caveat: NO ownership or access field. Schedule 10 includes a large share of trees on private residential property, so hard rule 10 has NOT been applied by the data: every dot needs a per-tree access check (address from Schedule 10 via schedule_id) before it may be shown or promoted. No girth, height or age. Species is a common name only. position_verified is the layer own TYPE domain (1 Verified position of tree, 2 Unverified position of tree): 2,945 verified, 655 unverified on the day of import; treat unverified ones as approximate even beyond the usual register default. VALIDATIONSTATE is 3 (Valid and Public) on every row, which is a record state and says nothing about land ownership.
